verdict.rationale: v0's Projects feature lets multiple chats share deployment, hosting, and domains, and GitHub integration supports branches, PRs, and CI which enables team-based workflows, but there is no direct evidence of built-in team member invitations, roles, or permissions within a shared v0 workspace. missing for 10: explicit team/member management, role-based access control, evidence of simultaneous multi-user editing within v0 itself.
